lines.name: Boulevard Line
lines.beyond: south to Southside: through-running; second terminus and depot off-sheet

lines.name: Skyport Line
lines.beyond: west to the West End along Circus Road

notes: Kept: T1 on the Boulevard reservation from sheet edge z -780, turning on the circus balloon. Bends are R 25 and R 28 (radiusLoop 25); the r 28 corners make a 28 m arc inside the 31 m island. The loop joins both tracks at ±1.8. Also kept: S1 as one straight trunk over median, island, mall and pier, turning on an R 40 loop over the water. No dead ends: T1 leaves at z -780, S1 at x -400.

One change: S1's trunk now runs to x 575 (was 560), with the same loop shape starting there. Bends stay R 40 or more and the first fillet fits (25 m segment, 18.1 m tangent). x 575 is still over the apron quay. This makes room for a Skyport station further east; the stations as placed are 190 m apart (Harbour 340, Skyport 530), below the 200 minimum.

Not adopted from tide's draft, the two-way Sky Loop round the district. Going round the district puts the beam over plots and pylons onto whatever is underneath, which breaks S-C1 and S-P2. One straight trunk over public space keeps every pylon in a median, mall, island, quay or water zone.

Not adopted (yet), T2 on Harbour Road. No rule needs it, and Harbour Road stops at Comet Row (z -720) short of the sheet edge (-780), so T2 would need a street-space turning loop there. If transit.reach 250 fails for the Harbour, Docks or Lantern areas, add T1 stops first, then reconsider T2.
Interchange (N-C1): T1 stop 'circus' at (0, -72) to S1 'Crown Circus' at (95, 0) is about 119 m, within skyrail.interchange 150.
Source conflict for Aster: notes › why describes an older state (single track, no loop, Sphere sky loop, separate harbour line). It contradicts the current lines and notes › concept. It looks stale.

Checker risk: the crown-circus road 'via' is a chord polygon, not a ring. If T-C1 reads it literally, the loop diagonal from (-1.8,-45) to (-28,-19) runs about 6 to 7 m off the chord (half-width 6), just outside the island. The fix would be a ring road (radius 37, w 12), not a looser rule.
Evidence: I have no shell in this run, so I did not run the plan checker; these checks are worked by hand against the standards. `bun tools/plan/cli.ts` must exit 0.

handoffs.ask: S1 stations break stationSpacing [200, 500]: Harbour (340) to Skyport (530) is 190 m. The S1 trunk now runs to x 575. Move Skyport to about x 545 (a 50 m station fits 520 to 570 on the apron), or move Harbour to about x 325, so every gap is at least 200 m.

When you place stops, check transit.reach 250 for the Harbour, Docks and Lantern areas. If any area is out of reach, add a T1 stop on the Boulevard trunk (spacing 300 to 500) before asking for a T2 Harbour Road line.
